events.title: Beers + Maintenance | Trailside Tune Up
events.description: Hands-on maintenance clinic for all skill levels covering shifting issues, chain problems, brake rubbing, and valve issues. Cost is $30. Rain or shine event. Check-in 4:30-5pm with drink token and snack provided. For women 18+.

events.title: Test + Tune with Cane Creek Components (Again)
events.description: Suspension test and tune event with Cane Creek Components experts. For riders with suspension bikes comfortable on downhill trails. Meet at Explorer Loop parking lot. E-bikes not allowed. Limited to 8 spots. Email Dorene O'Malley to register.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Group ride in Pisgah and DuPont. Post-ride social at Oskar Blues Brewery (342 Mountain Industrial Dr, Brevard, NC 28712). E-bikes not allowed at either location. Registration through Eventbrite opens Nov 1 at 7pm. For women 18+.

events.title: Volunteer Appreciation Party
events.description: Celebration event for past volunteers with prizes, giveaways, food, and one complimentary drink. Partners welcome. Registration opens Oct 26 at 7pm.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Group ride in Hot Springs. Post-ride social at Big Pillow Brewing (25-27 N Andrews Avenue, Hot Springs, NC 28743-9231). E-bikes not allowed. Registration through Eventbrite opens Dec 1 at 7pm. For women 18+.
